metadata.name: bondtrace
metadata.description: Permissioned corporate-action prototype for tokenized bonds

accounts.name: executor
docs: Permissionless caller; opening fixes rights but cannot change recipients.
Kept first in the account list for legacy transaction wire compatibility.

instructions.name: settle_coupon
docs: Anyone may deliver an already-fixed coupon to its beneficiary. The
beneficiary never delegates custody and the same mask protects both paths.

accounts.name: executor
docs: Pays transaction fees; cannot choose the entitlement or redirect it.

errors.name: UnauthorizedIssuer
errors.msg: Only the configured issuer may perform this operation

errors.name: InvalidPhase
errors.msg: This operation is unavailable in the issue's current phase

errors.name: InvalidTerms
errors.msg: Terms, dates, name or amount are invalid

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Checked integer arithmetic overflow

errors.name: RegistryFull
errors.msg: The registry supports at most sixteen pre-registered holders

errors.name: AlreadyRegistered
errors.msg: Wallet is already registered

errors.name: UnregisteredHolder
errors.msg: Wallet is not in this issue's sealed holder registry

errors.name: InvalidHolderAccount
errors.msg: Expected the canonical holder token account for this bond mint

errors.name: UnsafeTokenAuthority
errors.msg: Token accounts cannot have delegates or custom close authorities

errors.name: TooEarly
errors.msg: The requested action is not due yet

errors.name: RecordDateLocked
errors.msg: Capture the due coupon record before transferring bonds

errors.name: Matured
errors.msg: Transfers and new proposals stop at maturity

errors.name: PendingCoupon
errors.msg: Capture all coupon records before beginning principal redemption

errors.name: InvalidCouponIndex
errors.msg: Coupon records must be captured exactly once in schedule order

errors.name: SupplyMismatch
errors.msg: Supply or holder balances do not match the sealed issue

errors.name: IncompleteSnapshot
errors.msg: Pass every registered holder account in exact registry order

errors.name: InsufficientReserve
errors.msg: The vault must cover all principal and coupon liabilities

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: This wallet already received this payment

errors.name: NoEntitlement
errors.msg: The immutable snapshot grants this wallet no entitlement

errors.name: SameAccount
errors.msg: Source and destination must be different accounts

errors.name: VotingClosed
errors.msg: The ballot window has closed

errors.name: AlreadyVoted
errors.msg: This wallet already cast a ballot on this proposal

errors.name: RecordDatePassed
errors.msg: Draft changes must finish before the first coupon record date

errors.name: InvalidPage
errors.msg: Expected the canonical page and the next sequential page index

errors.name: SnapshotLocked
errors.msg: A paged snapshot is in progress; transfers and registry changes are locked

errors.name: ScheduleIncomplete
errors.msg: Append the complete immutable coupon schedule before continuing

errors.name: SnapshotNotFinalized
errors.msg: Finalize every snapshot page before claiming or voting

errors.name: InvalidActionKind
errors.msg: The action kind does not support this operation

errors.name: InvalidHolderIndex
errors.msg: Expected the next append-only registry position

fields.name: holder_count
docs: Registry prefix frozen when capture starts. Later holders have no rights.

fields.name: face_value
docs: Settlement-token base units per whole bond, never floating point.

fields.name: holder_wallets
docs: Immutable after sealing; every snapshot uses precisely this order.

fields.name: revision
docs: Optimistic read fence for paginated RPC reads. Every program mutation
touching this instrument's economic graph increments it exactly once.

fields.name: active_kind
docs: Zero means no capture. One instrument has at most one capture in flight.

fields.name: unit_amount
docs: Settlement-token base units payable for one whole bond.

types.name: FinancialTerms
docs: Created atomically with a rate-based issue. There is deliberately no update,
close, or attach-to-existing-bond instruction for this immutable account.

fields.name: nominal
docs: Settlement-token base units per whole bond.

fields.name: unit_amount
docs: Exact settlement-token base units for each regular coupon.

fields.name: index
docs: Append-only; never reused or changed, even after a zero balance or burn.
